summary:
Buy 31 ceiling air devices, plus 3 ceiling exhaust fans (which come with their own integral grille) and 1 soffit eggcrate.

CEILING SUPPLY DIFFUSERS - 28 total. All are Price SCD except type J. The SCD is a louvered-face square 4-cone steel ceiling supply diffuser, 360 deg / 4-way fixed pattern, white, in a 24x24 panel for lay-in ceiling, with a full-faced louver, factory insulated backpan and a radial balancing damper in the neck (Price VCR9 or equal):
  - Type A, 6" round neck: 5 ea (75/75/75/90/130 CFM)
  - Type B, 8" round neck: 4 ea (150/150/140/140 CFM)
  - Type C, 10" round neck: 15 ea (250/200/250/250/250/200/350/350/350/300/375/375/300/375/375 CFM)
  - Type D, 12" round neck: 1 ea (500 CFM, Kilns 115)
  - Type J, Price SMD, 12x12 face with 8" round neck, white, 4-way, FLANGED FRAME FOR SURFACE MOUNTING (hard ceiling, not lay-in), with opposed blade damper: 3 ea (175/150/150 CFM)
Total supply air through ceiling diffusers: 6,550 CFM.

CEILING RETURN/EXHAUST GRILLES - 3 total:
  - Type F, Price 80, 24"x24" core-only panel, all-aluminum 1/2"x1/2"x1/2" eggcrate, white, in 24x24 lay-in panel: 3 ea (1 at the MP Room 119 / FCU-1 return, 2 in Mtg Room 106). Per M101 note 4 each gets a new 24x24 lined (1/2" liner) plenum on top.

ALSO CEILING-MOUNTED (order separately, not from the grille schedule):
  - EF-1 and EF-2: Greenheck SPA-700, 450 CFM ea, 0.30 in. w.g., 1100 RPM, 350 W, 2.5 sones
  - EF-3: Greenheck SP-B90, 75 CFM, 0.25 in. w.g., 700 RPM, 50 W, 2.5 sones
  All three are centrifugal ceiling exhaust fans with integral grille, flapper backdraft damper, plug/cord set, mounting brackets, factory grille-mounted motion sensor, factory disconnect and speed controller - so no separate exhaust grille is purchased for them.
  - 1 ea 14x14 eggcrate, Price model 82, mounted in a soffit with insect screen on the back (M101 note 19). Soffit, not ceiling, but it is an extra air-vent panel that is easy to miss because it is called out in a note only, not tagged.

NOT CEILING - do not include these in a ceiling-vent order (15 ea wall-mounted devices are also on M101): type E 30x18 Price 95 heavy-duty steel sidewall return grille x4; type G 36x36 Price 95 sidewall transfer grille x4 (2 wall openings, tagged both faces, top el. 14'-8" AFF); type H 18x8 Price 520D double-deflection sidewall supply x3; type I 14x8 Price 520D double-deflection sidewall supply x4.

WATCH-OUTS FOR PRICING: (1) The E and I grilles carry an asterisk on M601 - field verify exact dimensions before ordering; M101 note 7 says the engineer could not field measure the return grilles and 30x18 is approximate. (2) E, G, H and I ship PRIMECOAT and get 2 coats of field paint - verify color with the architect. (3) All ceiling types (A-D, F, J) are WHITE factory finish. (4) M601 general note 3 and M101 notes 5/3 require coordinating exact device locations with the architectural reflected ceiling plans, the lighting layout, sprinkler heads and the new Tectum panels. (5) Nothing is salvaged and reused - MD101 removes the existing ceiling supply, sidewall supply and sidewall return grilles and the existing ceiling exhaust fan, and the grilles/fans that stay (MD101 notes 18, 20, 26, 31) are untouched, so every tagged device above is a new purchase.

Sheets used: G0-0 (drawing index), MD101 (mechanical demolition - to confirm nothing is reused), M101 (mechanical new work floor plan - the device count), M601 (mechanical legend, general notes & schedules - the GRILLES and EXHAUST FANS schedules).
